description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Two forms. Called with no id: returns a list of what the team has for Joe, as ids only: each reply to one of his messages and each numbered question waiting for him, with its date. No text. Called with one id from that list: returns that one item: for a reply, Joe's message and the team's reply; for a question, its number, why it matters and its choices. One item per call on purpose: if your own safety check refuses one item, the others are still readable. Pass seen on every call: the ids you have already shown Joe. The team uses it to learn that a reply reached him, and rewrites one that did not. Read-only apart from that record. A reply or a new question can take up to an hour to appear.

id.description: One id from the list. Leave it out to get the list.

seen.description: Ids you have already shown Joe in chat. Send your whole recent list on every call.

name: replies_for_joe

item.description: With an id: that one reply or question.

waiting.description: With no id: everything the team has for Joe, oldest first.

title: The team's replies to Joe
